As the new version launches today, users who rely on the SmartGym iPhone app will find it more convenient to adjust and log workout sets during their fitness routines. Here are the details.

SmartGym makes it easier to adjust and log workout sets during training

SmartGym's Apple Watch app has always allowed users to quickly adjust details like reps and weight when logging each set.

With today's update, this flexibility extends to the iPhone app. Users can now choose between the existing logging interface and the all-new 'Inline Logging' interface, which lets them adjust values, log sets, and add new sets without leaving the same screen.

The new interface also adds a small badge in the bottom-right corner of the reps and weight fields, showing the values originally set for each set.

After completing a set log, SmartGym also starts the rest timer directly on the same screen, so users can continue their workout without switching views.

Here's SmartGym:

This matters because SmartGym isn't just about logging what you did—it's about helping you understand what you should do. Your training plan is designed to move you toward your goals. Displaying your originally planned sets alongside what you actually completed makes it easier to stay on track during a workout, and easier to see whether you're progressing over time.

This update also introduces a completely redesigned keyboard built from the ground up, making the logging flow during training smoother. The keyboard features buttons to quickly increase or decrease values, or switch between set types—regular, warm-up, and drop sets.

As SmartGym puts it: "Every second we save in the app is a second given back to you to do what really matters—training."

Finally, today's update also includes a redesigned 'Smart Action Button' that predicts the most likely next action a user will take and displays the appropriate action options at the bottom of the interface based on where they are in their workout.

Options include 'Log Set + Start Rest', 'Start Exercise', 'First Set of Superset', 'Update Set', 'Next Exercise', and 'Finish Workout', among others.

SmartGym says they have also improved the intelligence behind the Smart Action Button:

The end result is a feature that feels more natural and fluid to use. SmartGym handles all the complex work behind the scenes, while users simply see what they truly need at just the right moment.

One last thing: users can set the iPhone's physical Action Button to trigger SmartGym's Smart Action Button, allowing you to manage your workout more quickly during training without having to navigate through multiple layers within the app.

SmartGym is available for free download on the App Store and offers a variety of subscription plans.
